reliability_partial.name: discovery_fold_reliability
reliability_partial.reason: At least one seed meets top-10 Jaccard >= 0.3; held-out evaluation permitted.

plan.benign_damage: K_r(S) KL intact||intervened on control prompts, non-pad positions
plan.comparison_identity: comparison_donor_seed / comparison_recipient_seed / comparison_pair_key on every condition row

within_model_reliability.metric: top-10 Jaccard between discovery fold rankings (primary k=10)
within_model_reliability.adequate_if: At least one seed has top-10 discovery-fold Jaccard >= 0.3; fail only if EVERY seed is below 0.3
within_model_reliability.on_failure: Scientific early-stop: skip held-out for all recipients; validation transfer scoring remains available for native-gate recording. Not an execution failure.
within_model_reliability.interpretation: Below bar => rankings unstable; held-out transfer less informative. Not a confirmatory hypothesis test. Donor reliability does not by itself block validation scoring; it blocks held-out evaluation when every seed fails.

nontrivial_native_effect.metric: recipient_native_topk |D| on validation at each k in {5,10}
nontrivial_native_effect.adequate_if: For a recipient, pass if ANY k in {5,10} has |D_native(k)| >= 0.05 (nats/token). Evaluated from the full set of per-k native scores; independent of loop order (max |D| over k, not last-k overwrite).
nontrivial_native_effect.on_failure: Skip that recipient's held-out measurements; preserve completed validation rows. Unit may still be complete (validation-only).
nontrivial_native_effect.interpretation: If native top-k has no effect at either k, transfer on that recipient must not be interpreted as meaningful against a null native baseline.

damage_matched_transfer.metric: per comparison-pair D_transfer vs D_damage_matched and D_random under the same recipient/split (grouped by comparison_pair_key)
damage_matched_transfer.note: Counting pairs where transfer exceeds matched controls is too weak to establish meaningful transfer. Report per-pair D alongside K; do not treat '>=2 of 6 pairs' as confirmatory evidence.

prompt_level_observations.metric: per-instruction D and K keyed by frozen instruction_id
prompt_level_observations.note: Support descriptive paired differences and spread across the same held-out instructions. Do not introduce unregistered confirmatory tests.

descriptive_paired_statistics.applied_to: transfer-minus-control D differences at the comparison-group level (vs_native / vs_random / vs_damage_matched) and, when available, prompt-level paired differences on shared instruction IDs
descriptive_paired_statistics.note: Specified before execution for reporting only. No unregistered confirmatory tests, p-values, or claim thresholds.

adequacy_rules.scope_warning: n_seeds=3 is too small for definitive population inference. Held-out n=25 cannot support precise ASR population estimates.

engineering_vs_science.note: Workload/budget estimate version bumps (e.g. unitized schedule v1) are engineering. Scientific protocol changes require a dated prereg amendment (v2.2). Do not conflate the two.

forbidden_claims: Do not equate component index overlap with identical mechanisms.

metric_definitions.secondary_note: Must not silently substitute for D

joint_transfer.note: v2 budget under-counted held-out joint conditions (assumed 3 primary only). Engine schedules 5 conditions × 6 pairs × 2 k on both splits when gates pass => 3000 instruction-level D scores (=60×(25+25)).

pair_dependence_note: Reporting 6 directed transfers among seeds [42, 43, 44]. Pairs sharing a seed are dependent; not six independent replicates. Feasibility/measurement pilot only — not definitive transfer proof.
